title: A Survey of Inductive Reasoning for Large Language Models
best_for_zh: 想理解模型如何从具体观察归纳出一般规则的读者。
one_line: An ACL 2026 survey that organizes inductive reasoning methods by post-training, exploration, data augmentation, and evaluation.
系统梳理大语言模型归纳推理的训练、探索、数据增强与评测方法。
why: It distinguishes learning a general rule from merely producing a plausible answer on a familiar pattern.
inclusion_reason: An accepted ACL survey that explains how inductive reasoning connects training data, exploration at inference time, and evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html: Inductive reasoning asks a model to move from particular observations to a general rule. This is harder than matching a familiar pattern: with only a few examples, several rules can look plausible, and a useful answer must continue to work on cases that were not shown. The authors identify a practical gap. Induction matters for knowledge generalization, yet work on it had been scattered across improvement methods, task settings, and benchmarks rather than summarized in one account. This ACL 2026 long paper therefore surveys the literature; it does not introduce a new training set, a single model, or one universal score. For a reader, the central problem is to distinguish a model that has inferred a rule from one that has merely produced a convincing continuation of the observed examples.

归纳推理要求模型从具体观察中概括出一般规律。这比匹配熟悉模式更难：只有少量样例时，往往有多个规律都看似合理；真正有用的答案还必须能在未展示的情况上继续成立。作者指出了一个实际缺口：归纳能力关系到知识泛化，但相关研究分散在改进方法、任务设置和基准之中，尚未被放进同一套系统框架。因而这篇 ACL 2026 长文整理已有文献；它不发布新的训练集、单一模型或统一分数。读者需要抓住的核心问题是：模型究竟推断出了规律，还是只对已见样例给出了看起来合理的延续。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey organizes improvement methods with three levers: post-training enhancement, test-time exploration, and data augmentation. Post-training changes what the model learns before deployment; exploration changes what it can try while answering; data augmentation changes the examples from which regularities may be learned. The paper then relates these levers to existing benchmarks and proposes a sandbox-based evaluation view with an observation-coverage metric. That framing is valuable because a claimed gain in induction can otherwise hide very different causes. When comparing papers, ask whether the result comes from changed learned behavior, extra computation during solving, or a different set of observations. Also ask whether the evaluation gives enough and sufficiently varied observations for a proposed generalization to be meaningfully tested, rather than rewarding a short-term fit to the prompt.

综述用三个杠杆整理提升归纳能力的方法：后训练增强、测试时探索和数据增强。后训练改变模型在部署前学到的行为；探索改变它作答时能够尝试的过程；数据增强改变可供学习规律的样例。论文随后把这些杠杆与现有基准联系起来，并提出基于沙盒的评测视角和 observation coverage 指标。这个框架很重要，因为“归纳能力提升”背后可能是完全不同的原因。比较论文时，应追问结果来自已学行为的改变、解题时增加的计算，还是观察样例的变化；还应看评测是否提供了足够且多样的观察，使提出的概括能够被真正检验，而非只奖励对提示中样例的短期拟合。

title: Method
方法
html: As a survey, the method is literature synthesis rather than a training pipeline. The authors catalog ways to improve induction, summarize benchmarks, and derive a sandbox-based evaluation approach. The basic objects are observations, a candidate generalization, and an evaluation setting that asks whether that generalization continues to hold outside the observed cases. This representation gives readers a simple way to unpack a primary study. First identify what observations are supplied and what information is withheld. Then state the proposed rule in a form that could be tested. Finally inspect the unseen cases and the judgment used to decide success. A paper may look strong on the final answer while leaving one of these elements underspecified; the survey's structure helps make that omission visible without treating all inductive tasks as identical.

作为综述，论文的方法是整理文献而不是训练流程。作者归纳改进归纳能力的方法、汇总基准，并形成基于沙盒的评测思路。基本对象包括观察到的样例、候选概括，以及检验该概括能否在已见样例之外继续成立的评测环境。这种表示给读者一个拆解原始研究的简单方法：先确认提供了哪些观察、隐藏了哪些信息；再把模型提出的规律写成可检验的形式；最后查看未见情况和判定成功的标准。某篇论文的最终答案可能很好，却没有清楚交代其中某一环节；综述的结构能帮助读者识别这种缺失，同时避免把所有归纳任务都当成同一种问题。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper's evidence is structured coverage of methods and benchmarks, not a newly reported leaderboard. Its official abstract states that it summarizes current benchmarks and derives an observation-coverage metric. The evidence therefore supports a map of the field and a vocabulary for evaluating claims; it does not turn the reported scores of all cited studies into one directly comparable ranking. When reading a cited result, keep the original task construction, supplied observations, model, and inference budget visible. A result obtained after extensive exploration answers a different question from one obtained in a single pass, and a task with highly diagnostic examples differs from one with sparse or ambiguous evidence. The survey is most useful when its benchmark summary prompts a reader to recover those experimental conditions from the primary paper.

论文的证据是对方法和基准的结构化覆盖，而不是新发布的一张排行榜。官方摘要说明它总结了现有基准，并提出 observation coverage 指标。因此，这些证据支持的是领域地图和评估主张的词汇，而不会把所有被引用研究的分数自动变成可直接比较的统一排名。阅读某项结果时，应保留原始任务构造、提供的观察、模型和推理预算。经过大量探索得到的结果，与单次作答得到的结果回答的并不是同一个问题；提供高度诊断性样例的任务，也不同于证据稀少或存在歧义的任务。综述在促使读者回到原始论文、找回这些实验条件时最有价值。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The authors present this as the first comprehensive survey dedicated to inductive reasoning for LLMs. Its contribution is not a new optimizer, model, or benchmark release. Instead, it provides a shared map that places post-training, exploration, data augmentation, benchmarks, and possible sources of inductive ability in one account. This is more than a list of papers: it makes the intervention point explicit. Two studies can both claim better generalization while changing different parts of the system, using different observations, or asking different forms of extrapolation. The survey gives readers language for separating those claims before comparing their scores. Its sandbox-based evaluation perspective also shifts attention from whether an answer sounds rule-like to whether the proposed rule survives controlled tests beyond the examples used to infer it.

作者将其定位为首篇专门讨论大语言模型归纳推理的综合综述。它的新意不在于发布新的优化器、模型或基准，而在于把后训练、探索、数据增强、基准和归纳能力的可能来源放进同一张图中。这不只是罗列论文，而是明确指出干预发生在系统的哪一部分。两项研究都可能声称泛化更好，却改动了不同环节、使用了不同观察，或要求不同形式的外推。综述为读者提供了在比较分数前先拆开这些主张的语言。基于沙盒的评测视角还把注意力从“答案是否像一条规律”转向“该规律能否在推断它的样例之外通过受控检验”。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The survey cannot make all cited scores directly comparable. Underlying papers may use different models, examples, tasks, definitions of success, and test-time budgets. Induction also has a built-in ambiguity: multiple general rules can agree with a limited set of observations, so a correct-looking output is not by itself proof that the intended rule was recovered. The survey does not supply one common dataset or evaluation harness that resolves these differences. Use it to frame a question and locate relevant work, then return to each primary paper for its data, protocol, and evaluation details. In particular, check how observations were sampled, which held-out cases were used, and whether alternative rules could explain the same examples. These checks limit overclaiming when transferring a conclusion between benchmarks.

综述不能让所有被引用分数天然可比。原始论文可能使用不同模型、样例、任务、成功定义和测试时预算。归纳本身也有内在歧义：有限观察可以同时支持多个一般规律，因此一个看似正确的输出并不能单独证明模型找到了预期规律。论文没有提供一个统一数据集或评测工具来消除这些差异。适合先用它建立问题框架并定位相关工作，再回到每篇原始论文查看数据、实验协议和评测细节。尤其应检查观察是如何抽取的、使用了哪些留出情况，以及是否存在其他规律也能解释同一批样例；这些检查能限制跨基准迁移结论时的过度推断。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when choosing an intervention for a task that requires extrapolating from examples, or when a model appears persuasive but its generalization is uncertain. Its taxonomy turns a broad design decision into a precise comparison: should you add examples, alter post-training, or allow more exploration at inference time? The answer should follow the failure you have observed, not a generic preference for one lever. Its benchmark discussion is also a starting point for checking whether a claimed gain measures generalization rather than recognition of familiar patterns. Before adopting a method, describe the available observations, the desired extrapolation, and the test cases that would falsify the proposed rule. The survey helps make those design choices explicit and helps prevent a result on one task from being treated as evidence for every form of induction.

当任务要求模型从例子外推规律，或模型看起来很有说服力但泛化仍不明确时，可以用这篇论文选择干预方向。它的分类把宽泛的设计选择变成精确比较：应增加样例、改变后训练，还是允许模型在推理时做更多探索？答案应由已经观察到的失败决定，而不是对某一杠杆的笼统偏好。基准部分也是检查某项提升是否衡量泛化而非熟悉模式识别的起点。采用方法前，应写清可用观察、希望完成的外推，以及哪些测试情况会推翻提出的规律。综述能让这些设计选择更明确，也能避免把一个任务上的结果当成所有归纳形式的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the three improvement categories first, then the benchmark summary and the sandbox-based evaluation proposal. Keep two linked questions in mind: what exactly is observed before the model generalizes, and which unseen cases test that generalization? For every primary paper mentioned, note the intervention point, the observation set, and the condition under which an answer is counted as a successful generalization. The discussion of simple architectures and data is useful for separating a capability claim from a claim about a particular prompting style or inference budget. Do not read the taxonomy as a recipe that guarantees improvement. Read it as a comparison tool: it tells you which assumptions changed, which comparisons are fair, and what further detail must be checked in the cited work before drawing a conclusion about inductive ability.

建议先读三类改进方法，再读基准汇总和基于沙盒的评测方案。始终追问两个相连的问题：模型在概括前究竟看到了什么，又用哪些未见情况检验这种概括？面对每篇被提及的原始论文，记录干预发生的位置、观察集合，以及什么条件下答案才算成功泛化。论文关于简单架构和数据的讨论，有助于区分能力本身的结论与某种提示风格或推理预算带来的结论。不要把分类框架读成保证提升的配方；应把它当成比较工具：它指出哪些假设被改变、哪些比较才公平，以及在对归纳能力下结论前还必须回到引用论文核对哪些细节。
